summary: Phase 2B backend-only regression PASSED. All 13 pytest cases green covering: /api/health, web-cookie login (no token in body), native-mobile login (token in body), public /auth/sso-config/native shape, /auth/google/native and /auth/apple/native error branches (400 missing + 401 garbage, no 500), /auth/me via Bearer, /api/scenarios via Bearer, /conversations/voice-message audio_format field accepted (returns 404 not 422), push-token register+delete, and full coaching regression (start + message → assistant_message returned; LLM path unaffected, circuit breaker NOT paused).

minor.issue: On the garbage-token 401 branch, the WARNING log line 'Native Google id_token verification failed: Wrong number of segments in token: b\'not-a-real-google-token\'' includes the raw token string that the client sent. This is because google-auth's ValueError echoes the malformed token in its exception message, and routes/auth.py:7034 does f'{exc}'. For real 3-segment JWTs this path won't fire (signature-verification errors don't echo the token), so real Google id_tokens are not leaked. Still, consider logging only exc.__class__.__name__ or a truncated hash for defense-in-depth. Middleware AUTH_TOKEN_REDACT_PATHS correctly protects request-body logging; this is app-level exception logging, which is outside that scope.

9_voice_message_audio_format.note: Proves audio_format='m4a' is accepted by VoiceMessageRequest model (Pydantic did not reject); endpoint reached DB lookup and returned expected 404 for nonexistent conversation_id.

11_coaching_regression.llm_circuit_breaker_state: NOT paused during this run — LLM path fully exercised end-to-end

token_redaction_middleware.http_request_log_lines_confirmed: middleware logs only 'method=POST path=/api/auth/google/native status=400|401' with NO token body dump — redaction intact.
token_redaction_middleware.app_level_exception_log_note: See minor issue above — google-auth ValueError text (which echoes malformed non-JWT tokens) reaches WARNING log via f'{exc}'. Only affects garbage-shape tokens, not real 3-segment JWTs.

action_items: OPTIONAL (defense-in-depth): In routes/auth.py:7034 and :7105, log exc.__class__.__name__ instead of full str(exc) so google-auth/PyJWT can't accidentally echo the raw token bytes in ERROR/WARNING logs. Not blocking — real JWTs won't trigger this path.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/auth.py:6923-6935 native_sso_config — correctly public (no Depends(get_current_user)), reads only non-secret client IDs, returns None for unset env vars via 'or None'. Contract matches spec (google_android_client_id null when env missing).

routes/auth.py:6938-7011 _issue_native_sso_session — clean find-or-create; deletes prior sessions to prevent replay; uses _auth_token_payload(request, ...) so token-in-body is still gated by X-Client-Platform header (native-only). Good.

routes/auth.py:7014-7055 google_native_auth — validates id_token present (400), verifies via google.oauth2.id_token.verify_oauth2_token in a thread (non-blocking), then re-checks iss/aud/email/email_verified. All error paths return 401, no 500 surface confirmed by tests.

routes/auth.py:7070-7126 apple_native_auth — uses PyJWKClient with cache_keys=True (good — avoids per-request JWKS fetch), audience list built from APPLE_BUNDLE_ID + APPLE_CLIENT_ID, correlate-by-apple_id fallback for re-auth cases where email is omitted. Solid.

routes/core_platform.py:116-120 VoiceMessageRequest.audio_format defaults to 'webm' — backward compatible with existing web clients. L1670 alnum-only sanitization prevents path traversal in tempfile suffix. Good.

routes/notifications.py:80-98 register_push_token — proper upsert on user_id, stores updated_at ISO timestamp, requires auth. Delete counterpart at :134-142 removes all tokens for user (idempotent, no-op if none). Both endpoints depend on get_current_user which supports Bearer + cookie — mobile-ready.

middleware.py:609-618 AUTH_TOKEN_REDACT_PATHS correctly extended to include the new native paths; confirmed no request-body dumps in logs. See minor issue above for app-level exception logging suggestion.
test_credentials: admin@realaicoach.app (password from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — verified working on both web-cookie and native-Bearer login paths.

One conversation may have been created by the coaching-regression test (test_coaching_start_and_message) under admin user_id — not cleaned up, but harmless (Conversation collection is expected to accumulate).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2B native mobile backend surface (google/apple native SSO verification, voice-message audio_format, push-token lifecycle) all validated. Full pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_phase2b_native_mobile_regression.py — reusable regression. Notable env state observed this run: LLM circuit breaker is CURRENTLY NOT paused (iter12 saw paused=true; the coaching-message call succeeded end-to-end in ~2s). Google native uses GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID + GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID as allowed audiences (GOOGLE_ANDROID_CLIENT_ID not set → android client id in /auth/sso-config/native is null by design). Apple native uses PyJWKClient (cache_keys=True) with allowed_audiences = {APPLE_BUNDLE_ID, APPLE_CLIENT_ID}. To exercise success paths in future, real Google id_tokens must be signed for one of these audiences; real Apple identity_tokens must be signed with an ES256 key from appleid.apple.com/auth/keys and issued for com.realaicoach.app or com.realaicoach.signin.
